title: A Common Map Makes Greenland Rival An Africa Fourteen Times Larger
hook: The map's biggest distortion grows farther from the equator.
closing: Mercator maps inflate distant land, so trust measured area over the familiar picture.
question: Which country looks wrong on maps?

segments.say: Africa is about fourteen times bigger than Greenland. The common map makes them look far closer in size.
At sixty degrees, a Mercator map makes land look four times too big.
Africa exceeds the US, China, India and Japan combined by about seven million square kilometers.
